# GhostSoap

> A free, local-first command-line tool that prepares Australian Privacy Act requests to
> data brokers for you to send from your own mailbox. It makes no network connections and
> does not yet track what you sent or the replies.

Status: milestone M2, version 0.1.0, with no GitHub release or published package. Build
from source with `cargo build --release`; `rust-toolchain.toml` pins the compiler.
GhostSoap provides information and templates, not legal advice.

## Start

- [README](https://github.com/EquityBot/GhostSoap#readme): commands, safety, what leaves your machine and what it will not do.
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/EquityBot/GhostSoap/blob/main/skills/ghostsoap/SKILL.md): how an AI agent helps choose requests whilst the person keeps their details and sends every letter.
- [Register](https://github.com/EquityBot/GhostSoap/blob/main/registry/README.md): entry fields and how `registry check` validates them.
- [Plan](https://github.com/EquityBot/GhostSoap/blob/main/docs/plan.md): legal model, threat model and milestones.

## Docs

- [Provenance](https://github.com/EquityBot/GhostSoap/blob/main/docs/provenance.md): where each register entry's lead came from and what verified it.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/EquityBot/GhostSoap/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): clean-room rules and the checks to run before a pull request.
- [Security](https://github.com/EquityBot/GhostSoap/blob/main/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability privately.
